brands.evidence: Yes, lots of people in the UK use Monzo as their main account.
Many people hold a second account, such as a high-street bank or Starling

client_claims.text: It's a UK bank authorised by the PRA and regulated by the PRA and FCA
The FSCS limit rose from £85,000 to £120,000 on 1 December 2025.
client_claims.note: The £120,000 limit matches; the date and previous limit are not covered.
Joint account limit not in facts, though it follows from the per-person limit.

client_claims.text: The basic account has no monthly fee and no minimum deposit.
client_claims.note: The facts list paid plans but do not say the free plan has no monthly fee or minimum deposit.

client_claims.text: Fee-free withdrawals depend on meeting Monzo's criteria: at least £500 paid in over a rolling 35-day period plus an active direct debit.
client_claims.note: F7 gives allowances but not this criteria; it is not directly contradicted.

client_claims.text: Monzo only supports making direct debit payments, not receiving them.
You can pay direct debits and standing orders straight from a Regular pot.
You can use the Current Account Switch Service to move everything over to Monzo.
There are no branches; everything is done through the app and online.
